'''Devour Force''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] employed by [[Tenebrae]]&mdash;otherwise known as Darth Vitiate or Valkorion. The ability would harm its target, generally looking looking like a [[Color/Legends|pink]] beam of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energy. Tenebrae made use of this during the fight that lead to his final [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught" />
